dog.description_text:
Applejack is a 3-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 12 lbs and is looking for someone who understands that good things sometimes take a little time.

He’s very shy and timid in new situations, so he’ll need a patient adopter who’s willing to let him settle in at his own pace and show him that he’s safe. Applejack is incredibly gentle, and while he may not be ready to jump straight into your lap on day one, there’s a very sweet dog in there waiting to feel comfortable enough to show himself.

With time, consistency, and a little patience, we know Applejack has all the makings of a loving, devoted companion.

Registered adopters interested in Applejack can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
